desc.factoryascent.quern: Hand-cranked millstone: grinds raw ore into dust (1 + 50% chance of a second). Sneak + right-click or use the Crank button.
desc.factoryascent.brick_kiln: Fuel-fired kiln that alloys copper and tin into bronze.
desc.factoryascent.sieve: Sifts gravel, sand, dirt and soul sand for flint, clay, seeds and nuggets. Sneak + right-click or use the Crank button; a Water Wheel or Windmill can turn it for you.
desc.factoryascent.drying_rack: Air-dries what hangs on it: rotten flesh into leather, kelp, wet sponges. Needs no fuel, only time.
desc.factoryascent.water_wheel: Turns in water (flowing water turns it fastest) and cranks the Quern or Sieve next to it for you.
desc.factoryascent.windmill: Turns in the wind, faster the higher it stands and in storms, and cranks the Quern or Sieve next to it. Its sails need open air in front.
desc.factoryascent.burner_crusher: Fuel-powered crusher: 2 dust per raw ore.
desc.factoryascent.burner_press: Fuel-powered press: plates, gears, rods and wires depending on the mould.
desc.factoryascent.coke_oven: Multiblock controller: bakes coal into coke (and logs into charcoal). Needs no fuel.
desc.factoryascent.blast_furnace: Multiblock controller: turns iron into steel, burning coke.
desc.factoryascent.electric_furnace: Smelts anything a furnace can, five times faster, plus aluminium.
desc.factoryascent.crusher: 2 dust per raw ore (3 per ore block) plus a chance of a byproduct.
desc.factoryascent.metal_press: Fast electric press. The mould decides what it makes.
desc.factoryascent.alloy_smelter: Alloys bronze, steel and silicon quickly.
desc.factoryascent.assembler: Builds circuits, motors and machine frames from parts.
desc.factoryascent.solar_panel: 8 FE/t in daylight under open sky (half in rain).
desc.factoryascent.auto_farmer: Harvests ripe crops in a 9×9 field in front of it and replants them.
desc.factoryascent.energy_cell: Stores energy. Charges items in its slot.
desc.factoryascent.charger: Charges any FE item (drill, rays, magnet, goggles, jetpacks…) fast and hands it out when full, so pipes can run it.
desc.factoryascent.floodlight: Throws bright light up to 28 blocks where it points. Uses a trickle of power.
desc.factoryascent.miner: Claims its own chunk in The Deep, a sealed mining dimension, and digs out its ore.
desc.factoryascent.geothermal_generator: 24 FE/t for every lava source touching it. The lava is never used up.
desc.factoryascent.ore_washer: Washes raw ore into 3 dust (4 from ore blocks), with a better byproduct chance.
desc.factoryascent.block_breaker: Breaks the block in front of it and keeps the drops. A tool in its slot lends it its enchantments.
desc.factoryascent.block_placer: Places blocks from its inventory in the space in front of it.
desc.factoryascent.vacuum_hopper: Pulls dropped items within 6 blocks into its inventory, then pushes them into a chest or pipe touching it.
desc.factoryascent.tree_farm: Plants saplings in a 7×7 field in front of it and fells the trees that grow. Bone meal speeds them up.
desc.factoryascent.induction_smelter: Induction heating: the only smelter hot enough for titanium. Also smelts anything a furnace can, very fast.
desc.factoryascent.hydraulic_press: Presses titanium into plates and gears. The mould decides what it makes.
desc.factoryascent.industrial_grinder: 4 dust per raw ore (5 per ore block) with two byproduct chances. Runs every crushing recipe, fast.
desc.factoryascent.recycler: Turns junk (cobblestone, dirt, rotten flesh…) into scrap, and worn-out iron, gold, diamond and bronze gear back into materials.
desc.factoryascent.mob_farm: Put a filled Mob Capsule in: it produces that mob's drops with power, without the mob. Bosses are refused.
desc.factoryascent.centrifuge: Gas centrifuge cascade: enriches uranium (3 dust into 1 enriched + 2 depleted) and reprocesses spent fuel into nuclear waste and RTG pellets.
desc.factoryascent.precision_assembler: Clean-room assembler for spacecraft parts such as the Orbital Targeting Core.
desc.factoryascent.plasma_forge: Forges quantum alloy in a plasma arc: the way into the Quantum age.
desc.factoryascent.electrolyzer: Splits water: a water bucket and an Empty Cell make a Deuterium Cell; four Deuterium Cells give a Tritium Cell. Fusion fuel.
desc.factoryascent.fuel_synthesizer: Makes shuttle fuel where there is none: Martian ice into Hydrolox Cells, Helium-3 into fuel cells, Io sulfur into Rocket Fuel. Needs Empty Cells and power.
tooltip.factoryascent.miner_radius: Claim: %s×%s chunk column in The Deep
tooltip.factoryascent.generation_per_lav: Generates %s FE/t per touching lava source
tooltip.factoryascent.cell_front: Power comes OUT of the lightning-bolt face and goes IN through every other face. Right-click a side with a Wrench (or use the Sides tab of its screen) to make it the output. The slot charges tools
tooltip.factoryascent.cable_bottleneck: A network runs at the rate of its slowest cable
tooltip.factoryascent.pipe_rate: Pulls up to %s items/s per extracting face
tooltip.factoryascent.pipe_hint: Wrench a face touching an inventory to pull from it, or right-click the pipe with an empty hand
tooltip.factoryascent.crate: Holds %s stacks and keeps them when broken
tooltip.factoryascent.multiblock.coke_ov: Multiblock: controller at the bottom centre of the front of a 3×3×3 cube of Coke Oven Bricks
tooltip.factoryascent.multiblock.blast_f: Multiblock: controller at the bottom centre of the front of a 3×3×3 cube of Fire Bricks with a hollow centre
tooltip.factoryascent.upgrade_slots: Fits in the upgrade slots of electric machines
tooltip.factoryascent.mold: Press mould: decides what a press makes. Never used up.
tooltip.factoryascent.forge_hammer: Craft with 2 ingots to make a plate
tooltip.factoryascent.wrench: Rotates machines; sets an Energy Cell's output face; toggles item pipe faces between insert and extract
tooltip.factoryascent.electric_drill: Mines faster than netherite while charged. Charge it in an Energy Cell. 100 FE per block.
gui.factoryascent.crank_hint: Click (or sneak + right-click the machine) to turn it
gui.factoryascent.hide_accepts: Hide the list of accepted items
gui.factoryascent.see_panel: See the list on the left for what it accepts
gui.factoryascent.jei_needs_long: Needs a %s or a better machine of the same kind
gui.factoryascent.jei_needs_later_long: Needs a grade %s machine, unlocked in a later age
gui.factoryascent.not_accepted: This machine has no recipe for this item
gui.factoryascent.see_recipes: Click ? (top right) to see what it accepts

advancements.factoryascent.age_quantum.d: Breakthrough! Forge quantum alloy in the Plasma Forge

advancements.factoryascent.stone_drying_: Build a Drying Rack: rotten flesh dries into leather
advancements.factoryascent.stone_water_w: Build a Water Wheel in running water next to a Quern or Sieve: no more cranking
advancements.factoryascent.stone_windmil: Build a Windmill up high with open air in front of its sails
Forge a piece of bronze armour
advancements.factoryascent.bronze_backpa: Sew a Bronze Backpack: 27 slots you carry around
advancements.factoryascent.bronze_grappl: Craft a Grappling Hook and pull yourself up a cliff
advancements.factoryascent.electric_char: Build a Charger: it tops up any FE tool and hands it back full
advancements.factoryascent.electric_magn: Craft an Item Magnet, switch it on and never chase drops again
advancements.factoryascent.electric_gogg: Craft Night-Vision Goggles and wear them charged
advancements.factoryascent.electric_floo: Build a Floodlight and light up a field at night
advancements.factoryascent.automation_pl: Build a Block Placer (point a Breaker at what it places for an endless block farm)
advancements.factoryascent.automation_va: Build a Vacuum Hopper to collect every drop around it
advancements.factoryascent.automation_tr: Build a Tree Farm: it plants and fells a whole grove
advancements.factoryascent.industrial_gr: Build an Industrial Grinder: 4 dust from every raw ore
advancements.factoryascent.industrial_re: Build a Recycler and open a Scrap Box
advancements.factoryascent.industrial_mo: Build a Mob Farm Controller and feed it a filled Mob Capsule

advancements.factoryascent.electric_reca: Load an Ender Beacon with a pearl, link a Recall Charm to it, and channel your way home

advancements.factoryascent.automation_oi: Bucket some crude oil from a tar pit in a dry biome (or an oil pocket deep down)

advancements.factoryascent.industrial_tu: Build a Steam Turbine and drive it with a reactor's Coolant Port
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_fuell: Build a Fuelling Port next to a Launch Controller or a shuttle pad

advancements.factoryascent.automation_si: Craft a Minimizer or Maximizer Ray to resize any creature
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_pad.d: Build a Launch Pad: a Launch Controller surrounded by 8 Launch Pad blocks
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_wirel: Link a Wireless Terminal to a Storage Terminal and open it from anywhere with signal

advancements.factoryascent.outpost_archi: Cut planet rock into polished stone, bricks or tiles
advancements.factoryascent.outpost_marti: Alloy Martian hematite into Martian Steel
advancements.factoryascent.outpost_fuel_: Synthesize a Hydrolox Cell from Martian ice
advancements.factoryascent.outpost_quant: Etch Ionite with sulfuric acid into a Quantum Circuit
advancements.factoryascent.automation_ph: Craft a Factory Phone. Sneak-use it on machines to watch them

advancements.factoryascent.orbital_rtg.d: Build an RTG: steady power from a decaying pellet, even in space
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_elect: Split deuterium out of water in an Electrolyzer
advancements.factoryascent.quantum_tokam: Build a Tokamak Core and the magnet ring around it
advancements.factoryascent.space_suit.de: Make an Astronaut Suit and fill it with air in an Oxygen Compressor
advancements.factoryascent.space_jet_sui: Build an Advanced Jetpack into your suit: a Jet Suit
advancements.factoryascent.station_boots: Make Magnetic Boots to walk station decks in zero-g
advancements.factoryascent.xdim_ender_li: Craft a pair of Ender Links: tune both to one channel and what goes in here comes out there
Build a Quantum Entangler: items, fluids and energy between any two worlds
desc.factoryascent.storage_cable: Joins storage devices into one network
desc.factoryascent.storage_controller: Powers a storage network. Exactly one per network
desc.factoryascent.storage_terminal: Search, take and store everything in the network
desc.factoryascent.storage_interface: Lets pipes and hoppers insert into and extract from the network
advancements.factoryascent.storage_netwo: Craft a Storage Controller: the heart of a centralized storage network
tooltip.factoryascent.electric_drill.cyc: Sneak + right-click in the air: pick a mode. At a block: next mode
advancements.factoryascent.dyson_first.d: Put your team's first Solar Collector into solar orbit
advancements.factoryascent.dyson_receive: Power a Dyson Receiver with your team's swarm

advancements.factoryascent.dyson_25.desc: Your Dyson Cube is 25% complete: square orbits of collectors cross the sun
advancements.factoryascent.dyson_50.desc: Your Dyson Cube is 50% complete: a cube frame closes around the sun
advancements.factoryascent.dyson_100.des: Complete a Dyson Cube: the whole light of the sun is yours

tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_collector_la: Fire it into solar orbit with a Mass Driver (or one per rocket from a Launch Pad)
tooltip.factoryascent.mass_driver: Electromagnetic launcher: fires Solar Collectors straight up into solar orbit, for your team's Dyson swarm
tooltip.factoryascent.mass_driver_multib: Multiblock: stack %s Mass Driver Rails on top, with open sky above them
tooltip.factoryascent.mass_driver_energy: %s FE per shot, at most one shot every %s s. Takes energy from cables on any side
tooltip.factoryascent.mass_driver_use: Right-click with Solar Collectors to load it (hoppers and pipes work too); sneak-use to unload
tooltip.factoryascent.mass_driver_rail: Stack %s of these on a Mass Driver: their coils fling the collectors to the sun
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_receiver: Turns your team's Dyson swarm into power: the more collectors around the sun, the more FE
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_receiver_pow: %s FE/t per collector in full sun (shared by your receivers), up to %s FE/t per receiver
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_receiver_mul: Multiblock: surround it with 8 Receiver Arrays. Needs open sky and daylight (always on in space)
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_receiver_out: Energy comes out of the bottom (and top) of the centre block
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_receiver_arr: Eight of these around a Dyson Receiver make its 3×3 rectenna
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_monitor_squa: It's Minecraft. The sun is square.
tooltip.factoryascent.dyson_monitor: Shows your team's Dyson Cube: a hologram on top, and progress, power and milestones on right-click

jei.factoryascent.xdim.ender_link: Ender Link (Automation age): endpoints tuned to the same channel share items and fluids, inside one dimension or between the Overworld and the Nether. Free to run.
jei.factoryascent.xdim.quantum_entangler: Quantum Entangler (Quantum age): items, fluids and energy between any two dimensions, orbit and planets included, much faster. Every transfer costs FE from its operating buffer (fed through faces whose energy mode is off), more between worlds.
jei.factoryascent.xdim.howto: Right-click to pick or create a channel (private to your team, or public) and set each face to send or receive items, fluids or energy; a Wrench cycles a face. Pipes and cables connect normally. A tuned endpoint keeps its own chunk loaded.
jei.factoryascent.xdim.lava: Nether lava: a Pump on a lava lake → fluid pipe → Ender Link (send). At home: Ender Link (receive) → fluid pipe → Magmatic Generator or tank.
jei.factoryascent.xdim.cost: Costs: FE per item and per bucket times the distance factor (1 in one dimension, 2 between two, +2 for each end in orbit or on a planet); energy loses a small share on the way.
